NURSING NOTE - BEHAVIORAL HEALTH LIAISON @NAME@ / Fields, Odette 31F MRN BH-0058142 Sunday 10/06/2075 RN: Colm Doherty (pager 508-555-0142) Location: Emergency Department, bed 14
2210 Asked by ED charge nurse to see pt - tearful in bay after laceration repair (R foot, stepped on broken glass at home last night). Foot already irrigated + closed by Dr. Priscilla Yeo, naproxen scripted, tetnus up to date. Pt says "I feel stupid" and "I always do this", denies intent to harm herself - cut was an accident, glass from a jar. Husband Terrence on his way from work, he is her ride, she wont let us call anybody else. Mother Rosalind Marchetti lives Fall River not close.
Pt oriented x3, calm after talking 15 mins. Not suicidal. No hx of attempts per pt. Safety screen negative. Gave the crisis line and the card for the clinic 508-555-0184.
Parking: security called re her car, grey sedan plate 4RTK-731 left in the ambulance bay, moved by husband 2300 (his spelling of the plate on the form was 4RKT-731 - same car). Belongings: phone, purse. Insurance card in purse: member id BCX 904-33-7781-02. Wristband applied by registration reads "Fieldz" - corrected. Allergies: Odette Fields <- label says allergies but that is her name, allergy list is NKDA per pt.
Discharged 0015 with husband. Return precautions. Note routed to: Dr. Nwosu-Bell (BH), Dr. Castellanos (PCP). Last edited by cdoherty on 10/7/2075 00:20 from 10.44.9.201
